d: Lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath puja par apne ghar lautne ke lie purvanchal aur bihar jane vale yatriyon ki bhari bhir relve steshnon par umar pari hai. charbag relve steshan se samne aae is khas vokathru men dekha ja sakta hai ki purvanchal aur bihar ki or jane vali trenon ki bogiyan yatriyon ki bhir se puri tarah khachakhach bhari huee hain.
